//: services/audit — append-only audit log microservice. Consumes `audit.event` from Kafka and persists immutable entries to Postgres for compliance, HIPAA tracking, and the Auditor role dashboard.
name: @caregiver/audit
//dependencies.nestjs: NestJS 10 on the Express platform — used for DI, lifecycle hooks, and graceful shutdown. The service is primarily a Kafka consumer (no inbound HTTP), but Express is kept as the underlying platform per the monorepo convention.
//dependencies.shared: @caregiver/kafka (typed consumer), @caregiver/db (Drizzle client + schema for append-only persistence), @caregiver/contracts (AuditEventPayload type).
//dependencies.data: kafkajs (Kafka client under @caregiver/kafka), drizzle-orm (query builder for the read-only query service), postgres (Postgres driver used by @caregiver/db). reflect-metadata + rxjs are required by NestJS 10's DI runtime.
